يشترطا (form VIII)
# يَشْتَرِطَا (yaštariṭā) /jaʃ.ta.ri.tˤaː/: third-person masculine dual non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِشْتَرَطَ (ištaraṭa)
# يُشْتَرَطَا (yuštaraṭā) /juʃ.ta.ra.tˤaː/: third-person masculine dual non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِشْتَرَطَ (ištaraṭa)
